description:
Ives has a household in the Yards whose figures have gone the wrong way for three quarters, and a quarter that closes on Friday.

The work is arithmetic. The arithmetic ends a policy.

"You will want to know whether I have looked at them," she says. "I have not, and I am not going to, and neither are you. That is not squeamishness. A number you have put a face on is a number you will get wrong."
name: A Number That Means a Person

objectives.desc: Run the household figures at the Gate before the quarter closes.
emotes: {who} works down a column of a stranger four quarters at a time.
{who} finds the quarter where it went wrong, and it is a hospital, and it is not interesting.
{who} does not turn the sheet over to see the name, which is on the back, where it always is.
